walkthroughs.body_html:
Beddington Zero Energy Development — 100 homes in Sutton (opened 2002).

Features: south-facing windows, super-insulation, rooftop solar, rainwater harvesting, distinctive coloured wind cowls for ventilation.

Residents use ~50% less energy than the UK average.

Curitiba (Brazil) pioneered Bus Rapid Transit in the 1970s.

Bendy buses in dedicated lanes, tube-shaped boarding stations for fast loading, single flat fare.

Around 70% of commuters use the BRT — cutting traffic and emissions massively.

Curitiba also runs Green Exchange: residents of favelas swap bags of rubbish for fresh vegetables — boosting recycling AND nutrition.

The city has over 50 m² of green space per person.

Lessons: clever planning beats expensive concrete every time.
